description.en: Recurrent binge eating with compensatory behaviours to prevent weight gain
description.hi: बार-बार अतिभक्षण और वजन बढ़ने रोकने हेतु क्षतिपूर्ति व्यवहार

mappingNote: ICD-11 Bulimia nervosa is 6B81 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (anorexia 6B80, binge eating 6B82, ARFID 6B83, pica 6B84, rumination-regurgitation 6B85) (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2); severity and remission qualifiers are selected separately.
